aiSummary: 今日聚焦国际政治领域。热点议题包括：10 dead after plane crashes；Bangkok fire victims were found；US Launches Strikes On Iranian。本日共收录 10 条重要国际新闻。

articles.title: 10 dead after plane crashes in the Bahamas
articles.description: Ten people died after a Cessna 402 crashed in the Bahamas. The Bahamas Musicians and Entertainers Union said Bahamian musicians and a DJ are among the dead.

articles.title: Bangkok fire victims were found trapped in windowless bathrooms
articles.description: Most of the people who were killed in a huge fire in a Bangkok music bar were found trapped in windowless bathrooms where they may have sought to escape the flames that claimed at least 27 lives.

articles.title: US Launches Strikes On Iranian Military Targets To 'Protect' Shipping On Strait Of Hormuz
articles.description: According to CENTCOM, the coordinated operation targeted dozens of military sites across multiple locations using precision-guided munitions.

articles.title: Comment: Banana industry should not restrict itself to conventional breeding
articles.description: Agricultural scientist Professor James Dale considers why gene editing may be the only sensible option to develop a new banana variety with effective disease resistance

articles.title: Gibraltar’s land border with Spain is about to disappear. This is what happens next
articles.description: In the biggest shift in 300 years, there will no longer be a land border between the two neighbours. Graham Keeley speaks to locals on the Rock about how they feel about the new changes coming in and

articles.title: France Announces List of 29 Countries Granted Visa
articles.description: France has listed visa-free entry for 25 of 27 EU states and 4 non-EU nations. Updated visa policies announced, reflecting a global trend in border access.

articles.title: One person killed in shooting involving federal agents in Maine, official says
articles.description: It comes less than a week after a man on his way to work in Houston was shot and killed by an immigration agent.

articles.title: Trump pushes for Lindsey Graham's sister as replacement after senator's death
articles.description: The South Carolina governor will choose a replacement for Graham, who died on Saturday, later on Monday.

articles.title: Aortic tear blamed in Sen. Lindsey Graham’s sudden death is a fast-killing emergency
articles.description: The aortic tear that likely caused the sudden death of Sen. Lindsey Graham is a medical emergency that can rapidly kill.

articles.title: Spain Releases List of Only 8 African Countries Whose Citizens Can Enjoy Visa
articles.description: Spain has named 8 African countries whose citizens are eligible for visa-free entry in 2026. Another option for other African countries was also mentioned.
